name: Methow River (Carlton – Pateros)
blurb: Dry-side canyon float down to the Columbia — mellow above Averill, splashy Black Canyon below.

sections.notes: Unimproved river access at both ends; toilets. Discover Pass or WDFW Vehicle Access Pass required at both WDFW sites.

putInAccess.operator: Washington Department of Fish and Wildlife
putInAccess.sourceName: WDFW Facilities GIS, Boat Ramp layer (feature 108, gravel)
putInAccess.note: Batch 2. Coordinate is WDFW's own boat-ramp feature. Esri World Imagery (z19, checked 2026-10-25, research/raw/batch2/carlton.png) puts it on the gravel bar about 7-10 m from the water. Legal access: WDFW Carlton Hole page (https://wdfw.wa.gov/places-to-go/water-access-sites/carlton-hole-481) lists 1 gravel ramp, open year-round, no camping; WaterAccessSites layer (https://geodataservices.wdfw.wa.gov/arcgis/rest/services/WP_RealEstate/WaterAccessSites/FeatureServer/1) shows WDFW-managed, no closure. Pass required.
putInAccess.bankSourceName: USGS NHDPlus HR flowline (flow-direction digitized) + Esri World Imagery
putInAccess.bankNote: Facing downstream (flow bearing ~120), the ramp is left of the NHD centreline. Confirmed on imagery.

takeOutAccess.operator: Washington Department of Fish and Wildlife
takeOutAccess.sourceName: WDFW Facilities GIS, Boat Ramp layer (feature 89, gravel) at WDFW's McFarland access
takeOutAccess.note: Batch 2. v1 'Averill (McFarland Creek)' is WDFW's McFarland water-access site. Coordinate is WDFW's own boat-ramp feature. Esri World Imagery (z19, checked 2026-10-25, research/raw/batch2/averill.png) puts it on a gravel spit under trees about 15-20 m from the open water, the furthest from the water of the batch-2 points, but on the launch path rather than the lot. Legal access: WDFW McFarland page (https://wdfw.wa.gov/places-to-go/water-access-sites/mcfarland-480) says it is at the confluence of McFarland Creek and the Methow, 1 gravel ramp, open year-round, camping allowed; WaterAccessSites layer (https://geodataservices.wdfw.wa.gov/arcgis/rest/services/WP_RealEstate/WaterAccessSites/FeatureServer/1) shows WDFW-managed, no closure. Pass required.
takeOutAccess.bankSourceName: USGS NHDPlus HR flowline (flow-direction digitized) + Esri World Imagery
takeOutAccess.bankNote: Facing downstream (flow bearing ~31), the ramp is left of the NHD centreline. Confirmed on imagery.

sections.notes: Black Canyon: Class III rapids with Black Canyon rapid (III+) at AW mile ~9.8. Bridge 1 Access (mile ~13) is an intermediate exit. Zahn's access is private. Discover Pass or WDFW Vehicle Access Pass at Averill (WDFW); Pateros take-out is Douglas PUD.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
